title: Concurrent sessions sharing one working tree race on git branch state (commit lands on develop)
body: Two opencode sessions operated the SAME product-forge working directory concurrently. While the architect session was on a feature branch, the other session committed to develop (BI-PF-0408) and switched branches, so the architect's commit (BI-PF-0392/A0, ab05323) landed directly on develop instead of the feature branch. Content was correct but the branch/merge process was violated.

rcca.root_cause: Concurrent sessions share a single git working tree; branch state (HEAD) is global to the working directory, so one session's checkout/commit races the other's.
rcca.corrective: Recreated the feature branch at ab05323, reset develop to f71e4fb, merged --no-ff (develop=1c24bf5, parents f71e4fb+ab05323).
rcca.preventive: One working tree per session: each session uses its own clone or `git worktree`; never run two sessions in the same folder. Documented in AGENTS.md + WORKER-SCHEDULER-OPERATIONS.md.

note: RCCA done; guard added (one working tree per session)
